intended_object: A predicate internal to the project: two functions on the lifted space `Lift` (radius × (slow parameter × torus variable)) agree at every point whose slow coordinate lies in `U` and has positive time coordinate. That is, they agree on whole slow fibers over `U ∩ {t > 0}`. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and how the library uses it (`FiberAgreement.fiber`, `continuedSource_agreement`).
explanation: The body is just `Set.EqOn F f` on the preimage of `U ∩ positiveSlow` under the slow-coordinate projection. It is shorthand for one hypothesis in this project's Navier–Stokes endpoint-continuation argument. It says that a function continued across `T = 0` agrees with the physical formula on fibers with positive time. The literature has no standard object it is meant to formalize. It is an auxiliary proof device made of Mathlib's `Set.EqOn` and project-specific sets, so it cannot be judged as faithful, too narrow or incorrect against a textbook notion. Read as what it claims to be, the body matches its docstring and its uses (`FiberAgreement.fiber`, `FiberAgreement.eventuallyEq`).
